description: Sorcerer/Monk spontaneous casting, Monk actions, component progression and persistence in the real engine.
prerequisites: Disposable legal fixture with Sorcerer/Monk, its shared GUI handler and the read-only checkpoint helper.
Legally created human lawful Sorcerer/Monk, local saves and real combat/rest/area transition access.
Installed-data progression oracle with separate Sorcerer and Monk levels; Monk component level determines fists.
XP grants may prepare low/middle/high progression but advancement occurs through the actual level-up screens.
instructions: Learn spontaneous spells and cast through the real spellbook/action bar; use Search, Stealth and Monk abilities against real targets.
Attempt representative allowed and prohibited equipment; observe actual equipped slots and item restrictions.
At each low/middle/high checkpoint compare both component levels, fists, APR, AC, proficiencies, skills, HP and saves with the installed-data oracle; include unequal component levels.
Verify identity, known spells and available casting after ordinary rest, temple rest, area transition and save/reload.
Run sorcerer-monk-tob-hla separately on a real ToB-capable fixture for the mandatory ToB HLA gate. Quit normally.
